messages:
eli_sales: Heads up: INV-8123 (HelioQ) failed when customer tried to pay with a virtual card. They said the issuer declined with 'authorization window expired'. Need options — onboarding scheduled tomorrow.

maria_fin: Do we have the raw decline code from the gateway?

payments-bot: Webhook received: decline_code `auth_window_expired`, gateway: Stripe, attempt_id: at_233333. Time 2026-03-24T09:12Z.

sam_ops: auth window expired usually means the token was created but not used within the merchant's vendor window. Could be our checkout flows holding the token too long. Any front-end delays?

nora_se: Checking logs for token creation/use pairing. If it's vendor-side, we can patch UI to shorten hold. For now, we need a quick payment path.

devon_support: Customer (alex_cust) replied in support thread: "Can we use bank transfer? We only have a virtual card on file, issuer won't reissue before Monday." They asked for an invoice hold for onboarding.

maria_fin: Two short options: 1) send a secure payment link for manual card entry (one-off) and have AE walk them through reusing a physical card, or 2) accept ACH via Plaid Instant Auth (if they have bank account) or wire. Wire is fastest but they prefer not to. Plaid could do instant verify and debit same-day.

eli_sales: AE prefers Plaid -> instant ACH if customer bank is US. Alex, can you confirm bank login option?

alex_cust: I can do bank login but prefer not to do a wire. Will do Plaid if available.

payments-bot: Recommendations: pause automated retry (to avoid duplicate), create temporary invoice hold tag `onboarding-hold`, and create a manual-collect job `manual_collect_233333`.

maria_fin: Pausing auto retry and adding tag now. Devon, send secure payment link + Plaid info fallback. Also add KYC ask: corporate registration + PO to help with accounting reconciliation.

devon_support: Drafting message: 

"Hi Alex — thanks. Two fast options: 1) Secure payment link to enter a different card now (link valid 60 minutes), or 2) Pay via Plaid Instant ACH (follow the link and authenticate your bank; settlement typically same-day). If you prefer a wire, we can provide instructions. Please upload PO and company registration here: https://support.redwood.ai/portal/upload.

Secure links: https://payments.redwood.ai/collect/oneoff/INV-8123 (card)
Plaid flow: https://payments.redwood.ai/collect/plaid/INV-8123

If you pick Plaid, we'll mark invoice cleared once microdeposit/instant verify completes. — Devon"

eli_sales: Good. Also note: waive manual-processing fees and remove the hold on onboarding if they confirm Plaid auth succeeded.

maria_fin: Agreed. If Plaid fails, we'll accept wire; AE to expedite.
